# PIE benchmarks

Results are comparable only within the same protocol section. A code link is not an independent reproduction.

## PIE ICCV 2019 intention estimation, location-only inputs

<a id="pie-intention-loc-iccv2019"></a>

**Task:** `intention_recognition` (original: pedestrian intention estimation)  
**Dataset release:** `v1` �� **Annotation version:** `author-release-unspecified`  
**Target:** `crossing_intention` �� **Split:** Author 50% train / 10% validation / 40% test pedestrian split

### Comparison setting

| Dimension | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sample selection | Pedestrian tracks sampled with 0.5 overlap; report the two location-only Table 2 rows, not later crossing-action results. |
| Inputs | trajectory; Observed track only; crossing action after observation is not an input. |
| Representation | Normalized pedestrian bounding-box coordinates (loc). |
| Observation window | 0.5 seconds (observation end) |
| Anticipation gap | not applicable |
| Prediction horizon | not applicable |
| Training policy | external_data: forbidden, pretraining: allowed, extra_supervision: forbidden, ensemble: forbidden |
| Evaluation | Binary classification of author intention labels.; Reported single test score for each model row. |
